reviewer: Pickle: official-source review of the consumer24 wireless massage gun comparison (6 brands, purchased 2020-10, published 2021-05-14), the Korea Consumer Agency medical-device damage advisory (2022-07-11), the KCA safety advisory on electric massagers (2018-04-25), the 2017 electric massager 9-product test, and the two Coupang listings opened live on 2026-11-19
method: Compared the draft against the consumer24 comparison page and its two attached PDFs (test-evaluation table and per-product results), read on 2026-11-19: the 2020-09 survey of 200 adults aged 20 and over, the 2020-10 purchase prices (Dr.well 156,000, Bodyfixcel 107,100, Xiaomi 70,000, Jespah 108,250, Theragun 549,000, Phoenix 42,500 won), body weight without heads (1,036/829/812/831/998/951 g and the second run 1,040/832/814/838/1,000 g), maximum-intensity runtimes (171/188/240/260/275/366 minutes), minimum-intensity runtimes (231/385/407/670/729/742 minutes), charge times (112/142/144/160/197/228 minutes with the 101 and 229 minute second runs), the 228 g spread against a 215 mL can at about 230 g, the ten-user sensory assessment, the 30-minute single-use estimate, the 10-minute auto shut-off note, and the two labelling failures (Xiaomi Meavon 3rd gen with no markings, Phoenix A2E missing the battery KC mark while its charger shows HU10920-19011 and XH2520-0450wD). The KCA 2022 advisory figures (452 cases, massage devices 129 at 28.5 percent, hearing aids 85 at 18.8 percent, quality and AS 276 at 61.1 percent, contract 99 at 21.9 percent, withdrawal 51 at 11.3 percent, advertising 18 at 4.0 percent, and the 27/34/40/13 yearly counts) and the 2018 advisory figures (262 electric massager injuries, 71/92/99 by year, chairs 148 at 56.5 percent) were read on the same day. The 2017 test figures (9 products, 49,000 to 139,000 won, 3 electromagnetic failures, 5 labelling failures, 2 power overruns) come from the consumer24 page dated 2017-01-24. Coupang was checked in the signed-in browser on 2026-11-19: Jespah Bodybolt ZP2420 at 89,000 won from 290,000 with a 10,000 won coupon, lowest new price 74,850 won, 9,026 reviews, next-day dawn delivery, KC R-R-ZSP-ZP4270 and adapter HU101015-19003C; Dr.well DR-2700 at 107,360 won from 149,000, 210 reviews, delivery on 11-21, listing name marked as a refurbished unit, KC YU101269-20002. Both AFFSDP deep links were tested and returned 302 to the intended product pages with lptag AF6593875. The affiliate block sits in one place after the FAQ with no top, inline or sticky box, per the 2026-11-17 approval-first layout; the article states that only two of the six tested models are still sold under the same model name.
